messages:
Jordan: Need a quick design check for the trace header. Two small asks: make the trace ID discoverable for mobile, and rethink the primary action from 'Export' to 'Share trace' (copy link + optional attachments). Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/def456/trace-header-v2
Keisha: quick read. Why change verb to 'Share trace'?
Jordan: users rarely download files; they share links in Slack/issue trackers. 'Share trace' would surface permalink + file options in a single menu.
Omar: ok but make sure the menu communicates what attachments are included (logs, spans, correlation ids). We should surface a compact summary line when sharing.
Lin: mobile concern: the ID currently wraps awkwardly and pushes actions off-screen. Proposal: collapse the ID into a pill with a subtle chevron to expand full id; tapping pill copies id. Also show full id in tooltip on hover (desktop).
Zoe: pill + chevron feels discoverable. For keyboard users, pill should be a button with aria-expanded and a visually-hidden label like "Show full request id".
Keisha: on desktop I prefer inline id + small copy icon. But I like pill for narrow widths. Let's define breakpoint at 640px.
Omar: backend: if pill tap copies id, ensure we don't trigger analytics spam. Debounce copy events and add copy_source: header_pill or share_modal.
Jordan: sharing modal: default to "Copy permalink" open, with a subtle toggle "Include spans and logs". If users choose to include logs, show estimated size warning.
Lin: accessibility: when the modal opens focus should move to the first control inside (per WAI-ARIA modal pattern). If the permalink is copied, announce via aria-live with message: "Trace link copied".
Zoe: also ensure color contrast on the pill text meets 4.5:1; current token color fails on dark headers.
Keisha: copy affordance copy text suggestion: instead of 'Copy', use 'Copy link' and on the pill use tooltip 'Copy trace ID'. Clarity reduces misclicks.
Omar: export formats: add CSV, JSON, and 'Compact CSV' that omits verbose metadata. Default share flow: permalink only. Download remains a secondary action in the menu with explicit labels (e.g., 'Download JSON (includes metadata)').
Jordan: good. Also propose keyboard shortcut: when trace panel is focused, press 'Shift+L' to open share modal. Needs to be documented in tooltips.
Lin: make sure shortcuts are announced in tooltips and in the keyboard shortcuts help modal. Also ensure they don't conflict with browser defaults.
A11yBot: Automated audit: header pills need focus-visible styles, target hit area >=44px, and menu items must have proper role=menuitem with aria-haspopup where appropriate. Report id: https://a11y.report/456
Zoe: UX microcopy: 'Include spans and logs' toggle could be worded 'Attach spans & logs (increases file size)' to be explicit.
Keisha: DOM ordering: keep title, pill, copy button, then actions to keep tab order logical. Avoid placing interactive elements after non-interactive elements.
Omar: API note: we'll add include_metadata=true flag and a format param. I'll add export_size_estimate field to response for modal preview.
Jordan: action items:
Jordan: - Keisha: update Figma with pill pattern, updated menu labels, tooltip copy and responsive behavior. (due Tue)
Jordan: - Lin: write a11y checklist for modal + pill, include SR messages and focus rules. (review Thu)
Jordan: - Omar: add API flags + size estimate, debounce copy events in analytics. (PR in 2 weeks)
Jordan: - Zoe: write microcopy variants and run a short copy test in the share modal. (today)
Keisha: I'll post updated frames when ready.
Lin: I'll draft the a11y tests after frames.
Omar: will add backend tasks.
Zoe: quick question: should the pill show a shortened id (first 8 chars) or a masked middle? Shortened is fine but show full on expand.
Jordan: shortened first 8 + ellipsis is fine as long as expand reveals full id and that copy uses full id.
Keisha: noted. Thanks all :raised_hands: 
A11yBot: Follow-up audit queued after updated frames are uploaded.
